complements: inputs/FULLBODY-MESH-MANIFEST.json (bodyparts3d-fullbody-r1: frontal, temporal, facial bones and mandible) and packets/face-muscles-r1 (Z-Anatomy face and scalp muscles); no id here repeats one there
purpose: Completes the cranium (both parietal bones, the occipital bone, the sphenoid) and adds the eyes (sclera, iris and lens of each eye), so the scalp and face muscles lie on a closed skull instead of floating over a hollow head, and the orbits are not empty. Requested 2026-11-11 for the user's Message 20 ("The arm and face muscles look the most wrong and disgusting").

source.atlas: BodyParts3D 4.0, The Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS)

rights: BodyParts3D, (c) The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Legacy OBJ headers (CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan) retained byte-exact.
not_included: cornea (FJ1289, FJ1340): a clear surface the game has no glass material for on the body; it would cover the iris as an opaque dome
teeth, ethmoid, vomer, palatine bones, nasal conchae: not needed for the outer look
galea aponeurotica (epicranial aponeurosis): no BodyParts3D 4.0 element
